answer.thought: The headlines are a noise of particular wills: a minister shouting about future defeats, a woman slapping a lawyer over a parking space. It is the civil society of needs and grievances, not yet the universal state, but it is the raw material from which the state is forged. I shall read them to see how the spirit is moving today.
